headers._note: files.content stands alone rather than extending files.base, so it needs this header of its own. A file a turn produced lives in the Workspace that turn was billed to; omitted when the client was given none.
headers.name: anthropic-workspace-id
anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access
headers._note: Only in a browser, where the download is otherwise blocked by CORS. Harmless on Node and Bun, but not sent there — the header names an exception, and an exception nobody needs should not be asked for.
